truth_boundary: Sourced part register for the V0.59 simulation-ready prototype CAD. Exact catalog items are used where the supplier publishes a stable part number. Configured-to-order items are real supplier products but require final ordering configuration from the manufacturer/distributor.
selection_rule: No pretend part numbers. Every modeled hardware family must be exact catalog, configured-to-order, or an industry standard with the reason and governing requirement stated.

parts.selection: THK BNK2010-2.5RRG2+499LC7Y
parts.requirement: Four independent corner actuators need at least 238.2 mm stroke with reserve for 203.2 mm stair rise phase correction.
parts.reason_selected: 300 mm listed stroke gives 61.8 mm margin over the corrected minimum stroke; 10 mm lead improves vertical speed so stair-phase correction can be previewed and commanded without forcing the user to pause.
parts.cad_representation: One ball screw shaft, ballnut carriage, thrust/support blocks, and stroke datum per corner.

parts.selection: THK HSR15C blocks on HSR15 rail
parts.requirement: Each moving ballnut carriage needs anti-rotation guidance and vertical load support over 300 mm travel.
parts.reason_selected: HSR15C has compact 15 mm rail class geometry with published block dimensions and kN-class load ratings far above the screening corner loads.
parts.cad_representation: Two vertical guide rails and two carriage blocks per corner.

parts.selection: maxon EC-i 52 part 633919
parts.requirement: Ball screw drive must produce at least 1323.9 N governing screened corner force and enough speed for previewed stair-phase prepositioning.
parts.reason_selected: 420 W EC-i 52 motor with 1.02 Nm nominal torque and 3990 rpm nominal speed gives both force margin and high screw speed for smooth no-break-stride stair phase correction.
parts.cad_representation: One actuator motor envelope per corner in the screw-drive stack.

parts.selection: maxon GPX52 UP configurable planetary gearhead, 3.9:1 one-stage target ratio
parts.requirement: Increase EC-i 52 torque while preserving high output speed for near-continuous 300 mm screw positioning.
parts.reason_selected: 3.9:1 ratio with 95 percent published peak efficiency screens to approximately 2369 N screw axial capacity and 170.5 mm/s linear screw speed, enough for 0.2 m/s stair approach with previewed pre-positioning.
parts.cad_representation: One GPX52-class gearhead cylinder per corner.

parts.selection: Ruland clamp-style shaft collars and configured flexible beam/zero-backlash coupling sized to GPX52 output and BNK2010 screw end
parts.requirement: The motor/gearhead must physically transmit torque coaxially into the vertical ball screw without pretending an unmodeled right-angle drive exists.
parts.reason_selected: Clamp-style collars and flexible couplings are purchasable machine components for shaft location, alignment tolerance, and serviceable motor-to-screw torque transfer.
parts.cad_representation: Coaxial motor mount plate, flexible coupling, and screw shaft collar above each ball screw.

parts.selection: maxon AB 44 24 VDC 2.5 Nm brake, part 386054
parts.requirement: Hold the screw actuator without backdrive when unpowered; braking is motor-side through the gear reduction.
parts.reason_selected: 2.5 Nm holding torque exceeds the calculated 0.331 Nm motor-side holding requirement with safety factor; smaller and more plausible than the prior AB60 choice.
parts.cad_representation: One AB44 brake envelope per corner in the motor-side actuator stack.

parts.selection: Thomson Electrak MD, MDxxA200 configured 300 mm stroke / 2000 N class
parts.requirement: Occupant pod must correct at least 36.03 degrees relative to the pitched stair-climbing chassis.
parts.reason_selected: Two 2000 N class actuators exceed the 514.9 N per-actuator screening force with safety factor and provide a compact sealed electric actuation path.
parts.cad_representation: Two pod pitch actuator bodies, extension tubes, clevis pins, hard stops, and positive level lock.

parts.selection: Dunkermotoren BG75 dMove with PLG75 planetary gearbox configured for wheel torque target
parts.requirement: Four powered wheels provide controlled forward motion and torque redistribution while corner actuators perform stair-height rampification.
parts.reason_selected: BG75 dMove class provides high continuous power and CANopen-capable drive integration; PLG75 family supports high continuous torque configurations.
parts.cad_representation: One wheel drive motor and planetary gearbox envelope at each wheel module.

parts.selection: ifm O1D100 IO-Link photoelectric distance sensor
parts.requirement: Preview stair tread/riser geometry so corners can pre-position before contact.
parts.reason_selected: 0.2 to 10 m measuring range, IO-Link, IP67 housing, and M12 connection fit the preview/control requirement without adding wheels/tracks/belts.
parts.cad_representation: Front/rear depth sensor bodies and bridge brackets.

parts.selection: Novotechnik TF1 inductive linear position sensor, IO-Link or CANopen configuration
parts.requirement: Each independent corner actuator needs closed-loop vertical position feedback over 300 mm stroke.
parts.reason_selected: Touchless absolute linear sensing, IP67, 100-1000 mm ranges, and industrial digital interfaces fit the corner actuator environment.
parts.cad_representation: One linear scale and one read head per corner.

parts.selection: Novotechnik RFC-4800 non-contact 360 degree angle sensor, sealed configuration
parts.requirement: Each powered wheel needs speed/position feedback for smooth low-speed stair approach and torque coordination.
parts.reason_selected: Sealed non-contact 360 degree sensor with IP67/IP68/IP69 options is more physical for this environment than a bare encoder IC.
parts.cad_representation: Magnetic target ring, pickup bracket, and sealed sensor package at each wheel.

parts.selection: Strainsert CPA/CBA load pins/bolts, custom-sized to pivot geometry
parts.requirement: Detect corner load sharing, stair contact, and one-wheel events so the controller can command whole-stroller response.
parts.reason_selected: Load pins replace clevis/shear pins directly, matching the suspension pivot architecture without adding extra mechanisms.
parts.cad_representation: Load-sensing pin elements and local signal-conditioning modules at each corner.

parts.selection: TE Connectivity DEUTSCH DTP connector family
parts.requirement: High-current sealed power branch connection to each wheel/corner module.
parts.reason_selected: DTP accepts size 12 contacts rated 25 A and 10-14 AWG wiring in sealed rugged housings.
parts.cad_representation: DTP power connector bodies at each corner.

parts.selection: TE Connectivity DEUTSCH DT connector family
parts.requirement: Sealed signal connection for sensors, local controllers, and safety interlocks.
parts.reason_selected: DT accepts size 16 contacts rated 13 A and supports sealed multi-position rugged signal harnesses.
parts.cad_representation: DT signal connector bodies at each corner and sensor branch.

parts.selection: TE M12 IP67 rail/industrial cable connector family
parts.requirement: Sensor connections need sealed M12-style field-serviceable cabling.
parts.reason_selected: M12 family provides IP67 sealing, vibration-resistant strain relief, and compact field-assembly options.
parts.cad_representation: Sensor connector blocks, conduits, and strain-relief mounts.

parts.selection: Littelfuse MIDI 498 fuse holder 04980923ZXT
parts.requirement: Protect left/right high-current drive branches.
parts.reason_selected: MIDI 498 holder supports 58 V systems with 150 A continuous / 200 A max holder class for branch protection packaging.
parts.cad_representation: Left and right branch fuse blocks.

parts.selection: igus iglidur G bushings and igubal EGLM-25 spherical bearing family
parts.requirement: Suspension pivots need dirty-environment tolerant, low-maintenance bearing surfaces and 25 mm misalignment support.
parts.reason_selected: iglidur G and igubal are dry-running polymer bearing families suited to dirt/dust and low-speed oscillating pivots.
parts.cad_representation: Bushing sleeves at link pins and 25 mm pivot bearing envelopes.

parts.selection: SKF 6002-2RS1 sealed deep groove ball bearing or equivalent 6002-2RS bearing
parts.requirement: Each wheel hub needs sealed radial bearing support around the live axle.
parts.reason_selected: 6002-2RS class provides common sealed 15 x 32 x 9 mm bearing geometry appropriate for the modeled compact hub stack.
parts.cad_representation: Inner and outer sealed hub bearings per wheel.

parts.selection: ISO 4762 socket-head cap screws; DIN 985 / ISO 10511 lock nuts; flat washers
parts.requirement: All plates, guide rails, thrust blocks, clevises, brackets, electronics, and sensor mounts need physical retention hardware.
parts.reason_selected: Standard metric fasteners are globally purchasable and match the modeled serviceable bolted architecture.
parts.cad_representation: Individual shanks, heads, washers, locknuts, and jam nuts across the assembly.

parts.selection: HellermannTyton HDM312 heavy-duty cable tie mounts and TY-series small cable tie mounts
parts.requirement: Harnesses need strain relief and serviceable retention at moving corners and sensor branches.
parts.reason_selected: Heavy-duty and compact screw/adhesive cable tie mounts are purchasable, UV-resistant polymer retention hardware.
parts.cad_representation: Harness conduit loops, strain-relief modules, and connector mounting plates.
